mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between GDPC1 growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO growth and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases are not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of UNRATE rising and PAYEMS falling is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the interaction term between UNRATE and PAYEMS is not significantly negative in a regression model (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals a weakening demand for housing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases > 10% in 1 month is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2% signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially during a late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% during a late-cycle expansion is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS levels and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansions.
